'''Tarrik''' (also spelled '''Tarrick''') was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an aide to [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and, years later, to his daughter [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] while she was [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. 

==Biography==
===Alderaan service===
In the years before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]], Tarrik was among the most trusted of Bail Organa's aides and servants.<ref name="CSWE" /> He helped raise Bail's adopted daughter, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], alongside other servants, taking good care not to pamper or spoil her.<ref name="DB" /> He continued to serve at court as Leia grew up, entered the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], and became involved in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="Points" />

After Leia completed a covert Rebel mission during the [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|Imperial Subjugation of Ralltiir]], she returned to Alderaan&mdash;for the last time, as it would turn out. She went to the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] to speak with her father. Leia and Tarrik greeted one another warmly at the entrance to the throne room; Tarrik informed her that she was to see her father immediately, even though she was dressed for space travel rather than an appearance at court. Bail had Tarrik clear out the room so that he and Leia could speak privately about her mission.<ref name="Points" />

===New Republic service===
While Bail Organa was killed in Alderaan's destruction, Tarrik survived.<ref name="CSWE" /> [[16 ABY/Legends|Sixteen years later]], <ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Leia Organa Solo had become Chief of State of the New Republic, and Tarrik again took a position serving the last surviving member of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]]. Alongside [[Alole]], he was one of Organa Solo's closest aides in this era, during which the Republic faced the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].<ref name="Shield" /> In this position, Tarrik had to obtain a high-level clearance<ref name="Tyrant">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> and enjoyed privileged access to Organa Solo's office suite.<ref name="Shield" />

As he had done for Bail, Tarrik managed visitors' access to Leia. She tasked him with bringing [[Chief Councilor]] [[Jobath Knox]] to her office so that she could personally tell him that she had granted his long-standing petition to admit his planet [[Galantos]] into the Republic. On the other hand, when someone "off-list" came hoping to see her, Tarrik would send them to other offices to manage their issue or vet them for a personal meeting with the Chief of State.<ref name="Tyrant" /> Leia commented to [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] that anyone not welcome in her office would need to "shoot your way past Tarrick."<ref name="Shield" /> In this way, Tarrik sent [[Belezaboth Ourn]], a former spy for the [[Yevetha]], to be vetted by the the intelligence officer [[Collomus]]. He then admitted Ourn for a conversation with Organa Solo on Collomus's recommendation. Tarrik was present when Ourn offered to reveal secrets to the New Republic&mdash;and when Leia physically attacked him when she learned that his spying had caused her husband [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to be captured.<ref name="Tyrant" /> 

When [[First Administrator]] [[Nanaod Engh]] advised Leia Organa Solo to begin a campaign to improve her public image, he suggested that Tarrik would be the best person in her office to manage it. Leia rejected the idea, though she later accepted it with reluctance.<ref name="Shield" />

Tarrik and Alole also concerned themselves with Organa Solo's security. While the Chief of State frequently ignored the rule that all ranking officials carry an active [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] while in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], Tarrik and Alole arranged that she always be accompanied by someone who did carry one so that she could be located in an emergency. When Leia was not physically present with her aides, Tarrik would contact a list of "spotters," officials with comlinks whom Leia was likely to visit. Tarrik initiated this procedure when she was nowhere to be found while the Yevetha were broadcasting an announcement of their alliance with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] at the height of the Black Fleet Crisis. Alole found the Chief of State napping in a private suite adjoining her office and commed Tarrik to arrange a hasty meeting with top New Republic officials.<ref name="Tyrant" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarrik first appeared serving Bail Organa in "[[Points of Origin]]," the second episode of the [[1981]] [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]. The episode was written by [[Brian Daley]]. Tarrik was played by an uncredited voice actor.<ref name="Points" /> He appeared as Leia's aide, with his name spelled ''Tarrick'', in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'' by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="Shield" /> The [[1998]] ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] first established that Tarrik in the radio episode and Tarrick in the novel were the same character.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
